'''Polixi''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Polith]] in the [[Polith system]],<ref name="WS" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Jaso sector/Legends|Jaso sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.<ref name="EAOC" /> Polixi was a barren rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="WS" /><ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All the planets of the [[Polith system]], except [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], were introduced in the first installment of a series of articles, ''[[Thyferra: Bacta Basics]]'', written by Cory J. Herndon for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Planet Hoppers]]'' web feature on [[Wizards.com]] in [[2003]].<ref name="WS" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Polith star system in grid square L-14.<ref name="EA" />
